generatedProse.practice-connection:
You now have a way of preparing that will serve you in every exam you sit from here on. Each topic you rebuild rather than reread, each technique you choose for a reason, and each paper you pace to the clock is this approach at work. The habit to keep is simple: produce and test what you are learning, choose techniques that make you work, and plan the exam day so your preparation shows.

The same habit carries into life beyond study. Wherever you prepare for something that matters, perform under pressure and have to stay composed, the same discipline tells. The people who do well are the ones who worked with their knowledge rather than only looking it over.
